title: AI Tokens - Consumo y acceso unificado
description: Consumo de tokens y acceso A2A/APIM desde customMetrics y requests de Application Insights. HTTP429 observado, sin atribuir su causa automaticamente.

list.name: service
list.label: Servicio APIM

azureLogAnalytics.query:
union (customMetrics
| where $__timeFilter(timestamp)
| where name in ("Prompt Tokens", "Completion Tokens", "Total Tokens")
| extend
    service = tostring(customDimensions["Service ID"]),
    agent = tostring(customDimensions["agent"]),
    product = tostring(customDimensions["product"]),
    subscriptionId = tostring(customDimensions["subscriptionId"]),
    department = tostring(customDimensions["department"]),
    team = tostring(customDimensions["team"]),
    user = tostring(customDimensions["user"]),
    model = tostring(customDimensions["model"]),
    Tokens = todouble(valueSum)
| extend
    service = iff(isempty(trim(@"\s+", service)), "(sin dimension)", trim(@"\s+", service)),
    agent = iff(isempty(trim(@"\s+", agent)), "(sin dimension)", trim(@"\s+", agent)),
    product = iff(isempty(trim(@"\s+", product)), "(sin dimension)", trim(@"\s+", product)),
    subscriptionId = iff(isempty(trim(@"\s+", subscriptionId)), "(sin dimension)", trim(@"\s+", subscriptionId)),
    department = iff(isempty(trim(@"\s+", department)), "(sin dimension)", trim(@"\s+", department)),
    team = iff(isempty(trim(@"\s+", team)), "(sin dimension)", trim(@"\s+", team)),
    user = iff(isempty(trim(@"\s+", user)), "(sin dimension)", trim(@"\s+", user)),
    model = iff(isempty(trim(@"\s+", model)), "(sin dimension)", trim(@"\s+", model))
| where name == "Total Tokens"
| project service),
(requests
| where $__timeFilter(timestamp)
| where tostring(customDimensions["API Type"]) =~ "a2a"
| where tostring(customDimensions["HTTP Method"]) =~ "POST"

    team = tostring(customDimensions["team"]),
    user = tostring(customDimensions["user"]),
    Code = tostring(resultCode),
    Successful = coalesce(tobool(success), false),

| where $__contains(subscriptionId, $subscriptionId)
| where $__contains(department, $department)
| where $__contains(team, $team)
| where $__contains(user, $user)
